item.title: Feature Request: Sync Copilot Chat session history between VS Code Stable and Insiders
item.body:
### Problem

When using the same workspace in both VS Code (Stable) and VS Code Insiders, Copilot Chat session history is not shared between them. Each application stores chat history independently in its own `~/Library/Application Support/Code/` or `~/Library/Application Support/Code - Insiders/` directory.

This means conversations started in one app are invisible in the other, even when:
- Both apps are signed into the same GitHub account
- Both apps have the same Copilot extensions installed
- Both apps open the identical workspace
- Settings Sync is enabled

### Expected Behavior

Copilot Chat sessions should be accessible from any VS Code installation where the user is signed into the same GitHub account with the same workspace open. This could be achieved by:

1. Including chat history in **Settings Sync** (as an opt-in category)
2. Storing chat sessions server-side tied to the GitHub account + workspace, similar to how Copilot Chat on github.com persists history
3. Any other mechanism that allows continuity between Stable and Insiders

### Use Case

Many users run both Stable and Insiders — Insiders for early Copilot features, Stable for production work. Losing chat context when switching between them breaks workflow continuity, especially for long-running agent mode sessions or multi-step debugging conversations.

### Environment

- **OS:** macOS
- **VS Code Stable:** latest
- **VS Code Insiders:** latest
- **Copilot extension:** latest on both
